findings.title: Emit uncertainty fields on the failure path
findings.expected_scope: 2 uncertainty VIOLATED on EXECUTION_FAILED cases; prevents future loss when executions fail
findings.change: When execution fails before the answer layer, still emit known epistemic limitations (e.g. age unknown, severity unknown) from the input profile into uncertainty_expressed.
findings.min_tests: Unit test: EXECUTION_FAILED path with known profile gaps produces non-empty uncertainty_expressed.

findings.title: Evidence field completeness assembly
findings.change: Ensure required_evidence_fields from the SUT contract (safety_priority, route provenance) are populated from real computation results rather than left as empty objects.
findings.regression_risk: LOW-MEDIUM. Must not fabricate evidence to satisfy completeness.
findings.min_tests: Contract-level tests that each required evidence field is populated when the corresponding computation succeeds.

findings.title: Renderer cleanup: deduplication, cross-domain filter, meta-text suppression
findings.expected_scope: 0 frozen criteria; 98 answers with repeated national blocks, 23 with cross-domain material, 1 with evaluation meta-text
findings.change: Deduplicate repeated national-information blocks, suppress cross-domain content not matching the query domain, and remove any internal status/protocol strings from user-facing answers.
findings.regression_risk: LOW. Purely presentational; must not remove domain-relevant content.
findings.min_tests: Renderer tests: one national block per topic; cross-domain fixture filtered; no internal status tokens in output.
